mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_run ( task_id, run_no, status, risk_level, summary, metadata, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid), #{runNo}, #{status}, #{riskLevel}, #{summary}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, run_no, status, risk_level, summary, metadata::text AS metadata, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM analysis_run WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

SELECT id, task_id, run_no, status, risk_level, summary, metadata::text AS metadata, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM analysis_run WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) ORDER BY run_no DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(run_no), 0) + 1 FROM analysis_run WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid)

SELECT id, task_id, run_no, status, risk_level, summary, metadata::text AS metadata, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM analysis_run WHERE task_id = CAST(#{taskId} AS uuid) ORDER BY run_no DESC, created_at DESC
